description:
Most recent published news from gol24.uz (Uzbek football news site), newest first. Use it for general questions ("what's new in football?", "today's transfer news", "what happened yesterday?"). For one club use club_news, for one person use person_news, for a topic or keyword use search_news.
Optional filters: type (transfer, matbuot = press quotes and interviews, natija = final match results, umumiy = other) and date (one calendar day in Tashkent time, YYYY-MM-DD). Filters can be combined.
Returns up to `limit` items (default 10, max 20), each with title and summary in Uzbek (Latin script), url, published_at (Tashkent time), type, clubs and people. An empty list means nothing matched. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute.

date.description: Optional. One calendar day in Tashkent time (UTC+5), format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-09-28". Omit for the most recent news.

type.description: Optional. transfer = transfers and rumours; matbuot = press quotes and interviews; natija = final match results; umumiy = everything else. Omit for all types.

name: latest_news
title: Latest News
